purpose: Evaluate how critiques and alternative perspectives modify and integrate into final scientific hypotheses across DS, MPDS, SAIR, and SES trajectories.

blinding.claim: Condition labels are masked, but complete architectural blinding is not possible because trajectory structures differ.

retain: all substantive stage text in chronological order
speaker or stage labels needed to understand interaction
remove: run configuration and local filesystem paths
packet_preprocessing.mpds_persona_note: Only enacted persona labels preserved in stored transcripts are supplied; persona summaries were not uniformly stored for legacy replicate 1 and are therefore excluded for all replicates.

evaluator.retry_rule: HTTP/API failures are preserved and stop the active batch. One deterministic retry is allowed only for an HTTP-200 response that fails strict local structural validation.

inference.replicate_aggregation: mean of three replicates within each condition and case
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction separately across the 12 prespecified dimension-level p-values for each test family (3 contrasts x 4 dimensions).
inference.emphasis: Effect direction, paired confidence intervals, and win/tie/loss are emphasized; non-significance is not interpreted as equivalence.

qualitative_example_rule.case_1: largest absolute case-level exploratory-composite difference for MPDS versus SAIR
qualitative_example_rule.case_2: largest absolute case-level exploratory-composite difference for MPDS versus SES among remaining cases
qualitative_example_rule.case_3: smallest maximum absolute exploratory-composite gap across MPDS-versus-SAIR and MPDS-versus-SES among remaining cases
qualitative_example_rule.representative_replicate: replicate whose paired exploratory-composite difference is closest to the case-level mean difference; ties use the lower replicate number
qualitative_example_rule.event: first substantive event in recorded order, otherwise the first recorded event

interpretation_limits: Do not describe this as a primary benchmark or preregistered superiority test.
Do not claim that MPDS is proven superior, optimal, or universally preferred.
Do not modify or rescore existing Pass 1, Pass 2, or SAIR/SES results.
